LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 8.3.1 WORD CLASSES: SIMPLE PREPOSITIONS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.3: Grammar in Use 8.3.1 Word Classes: Simple prepositions
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 8.3.1 Word Classes: Simple prepositions, part of Strand 8 in Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How do we show where a person or thing is? 2. How do you show the position of a thing or the time something happens?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify prepositions of position, time and place correctly,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Grammar in Use 8.3.1 Word Classes: Simple prepositions in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. use prepositions of position, time and place in sentences correctly,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Grammar in Use 8.3.1 Word Classes: Simple prepositions in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. appreciate the role of prepositions of position, place and time in communication.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Grammar in Use 8.3.1 Word Classes: Simple prepositions in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. identify prepositions of position, time and place correctly,

   Grammar in Use 8.3.1 Word Classes: Simple prepositions helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. use prepositions of position, time and place in sentences correctly,

   Grammar in Use 8.3.1 Word Classes: Simple prepositions helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. appreciate the role of prepositions of position, place and time in communication.

   Grammar in Use 8.3.1 Word Classes: Simple prepositions helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. identify the prepositions of position, place and time from print or digital texts,

2. construct sentences using prepositions of position, place and time and display on charts,

3. fill in gaps in given sentences using of prepositions of position, time and place,

4. search for sentences featuring simple prepositions from newspapers, magazines and the internet,

5. create crossword puzzles using simple prepositions, with peers. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. identify the prepositions of position, place and time from print or digital texts,
2. construct sentences using prepositions of position, place and time and display on charts,
3. fill in gaps in given sentences using of prepositions of position, time and place,
4. search for sentences featuring simple prepositions from newspapers, magazines and the internet,
5. create crossword puzzles using simple prepositions, with peers. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 8.3.1 Word Classes: Simple prepositions together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learning to learn: It is enhanced as the learner builds on their knowledge of simple prepositions to express themselves

clearly.

• Creativity and imagination: It is enhanced as the learner explores new ideas while creating a crossword puzzle using simple

prepositions.

Values:
Respect: This is developed as the learner demonstrates patience while creating crossword puzzles using simple prepositions,

with peers.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Citizenship education: Ethnic relations is enhanced as the learner participates in group activities.

Links to other Learning Areas:
The learning of correct use of prepositions is important when making presentations in learning areas such as Integrated Science.
